name: Orphaned workspace
short_description: A Microsoft 365 collaboration space such as a team, group or SharePoint site that is still active but no longer has a current owner responsible for membership, sharing and lifecycle decisions.

evidence.quote: You have drifted permissions, workspaces with no owners and external sharing that nobody ever reviews.
An orphaned workspace is a collaboration asset that still holds business value, but no longer has clear accountability.
Failure pattern two, collaboration sprawl and often workspaces.
Often workspaces are the most honest artifact of a broken governance model.
Each row a workspace somebody once believed they needed, many now onalous.
a soft blue banner that reads these groups have no owners, assign an owner to ensure proper management
